2609.39685.title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
2609.39685.paper_summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/
2609.39685.paper_summary_zh: 長期機器人操作在許多任務組合中重複使用技能，但通過額外的端到端示範來改進這些組合是有成本的。一個實用的自我改進系統必須決定接下來要教什麼以及在哪裡應用這種監督。我們提出了ROBOCOACH，一個以世界模型為指導的輔導框架，利用想像中的失敗來指導示範請求和專家更新。它的路徑-想像-診斷-改進（RIDI）循環在我們的共享行動條件世界模型COACHWORLD內執行可重用的技能專家，並使用進度評估器來記錄第一個未能完成的子任務。聚合記錄選擇要獲取的子任務示範和要更新的專家適配器。在兩個模擬套件和兩個實際機器人平台上，想像的成功和實際部署的成功在22個任務策略對中相關（rho = 0.840）。控制比較顯示，我們的輔導方法在匹配的數據預算和更新計劃下超越了匹配的基準。僅僅增加150個子任務示範，Franka的成功率從13.3%上升到75.0%，而AgileX的成功率從40.0%上升到83.8%。這些受輔導的專家也轉移到四個保留的組合中，實現了平均35.0%的成功率，而共享政策基準在均勻獲取的示範下的成功率為0%。總體而言，這些結果顯示世界模型可以作為主動教練，將想像中的失敗轉化為針對性的監督，以促進模組政策的改進。項目頁面：https://robocoach-ai.github.io/
